bank_finalizer.role: copy intact into generated Bank as ~finalize_bank.py; regenerates figures, silently applies MathJax v10/final-byte repairs, runs locked-inventory/course-family checks, reports focused review notes, creates final ZIP

standalone_mathjax_maintenance.role: framework maintenance/reference copy; optional standalone teacher repair tool, not a third generated-Bank production script

practice_review_rule: Repeated procedural families/skeletons are allowed. Do not audit Practice skeleton frequency. Report only exact duplicates if desired, high-confidence unrelated bundles, student-facing iteration labels, or repeated generic long trailing wrappers.
final_bytes_rule: Teacher runs self-contained finalizer after extracting authoring-complete Bank ZIP. MathJax v10 repairs are silent unless unresolved; blank solution fields are not report noise; hard structural/profile failures block PASS.
